notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
QoL Update.

Quality of Life Update brings the following..
[list]
[*] Better gamepad support,
[*] New option to turn off flashing,
[*] Cloud saves,
[*] Fixes to CRT shader,
[*] Support for newer graphics libraries such as DX11,
[*] Various minor tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: DTHC Patch Notes Feb 17, 2017
notes.content:
fixed: screen resolution problem on first boot of game.
fixed: audio menu loops back to 100 after hitting 0.
fixed: gamepad name not returned if gamepad id not 0.
changed: medipack artwork.
